visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses and a grey t-shirt stands indoors, speaking directly to the camera with an expressive face. (2) Close-up shots show black coffee being poured over ice, followed by a jar of yogurt topped with nuts. (3) The man prepares natto in a white styrofoam container, adding mustard and soy sauce with wooden chopsticks. (4) He mixes the natto into a glass bowl of fresh green lettuce and begins eating while sitting at a wooden table. (5) Transitioning to an outdoor garden patio at dusk, the man wears a green Adidas t-shirt and white shorts, performing stretching and jumping jacks. (6) He moves to a blue mat on the concrete floor to do push-ups and planks, while a brown dog lies resting on a wooden deck in the background. (7) Returning to the indoor kitchen, he holds a whole flat silver fish (pomfret) toward the camera before slicing bright red and green bell peppers. (8) The fish is shown frying in a large pan with garlic and ginger; later, he adds a fried egg on top. (9) At the dining table, he enjoys the colorful fish dish, drinking water and eating a piece of roasted sweet potato. (10) The video concludes with a simple animation of a boy lying down and a girl standing over him against a solid yellow background.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a clean indoor apartment kitchen/living area with white cabinets and wooden furniture, and an outdoor tiled patio surrounded by green garden foliage.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with high-energy speech from a young man over a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar track. A clear splashing sound of coffee hitting ice cubes punctuates the intro. (2) Sounds of a glass jar opening and plastic rustling transition into the breakfast phase, accompanied by casual conversational laughter between the man and a woman off-camera. (3) Rhythmic chewing and slurping sounds are prominent as the man eats natto and lettuce, with the BGM remaining steady in the background. (4) The audio shifts to include outdoor birdsong and heavy breathing as the man performs jumping jacks and push-ups; the acoustic guitar BGM continues to maintain the pace. (5) Fast, percussive thudding sounds indicate vegetable chopping in the kitchen, followed by a loud, sustained sizzling broadband noise as fish hits the hot frying pan. (6) Clinking of metallic pans and the lid being placed on the pot create a dense culinary soundscape before transitioning to the quiet, rhythmic sounds of eating and drinking at the table. (7) The video ends with a soft chime sound effect over the final animation frame.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Daily Routine (Breakfast) -> Exercise -> Meal Preparation (Dinner) -> Evaluation -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the 10th day of a 100-day weight loss journey, highlighting a healthy lifestyle through balanced low-fat meals and home workouts to inspire and engage followers interested in fitness and healthy living.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While brand logos like Adidas and LG are visible, they are incidental to the lifestyle vlog content rather than primary promotional focuses.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly engaging fitness vlog with fast-paced editing and detailed meal preparation segments, effective for clustering with personal health journey content.
